hints.title: Bounded Value Range
hints.text: Notice all elements in nums are bounded between 1 and 300.

hints.title: State Formulation
hints.text: Let dp[v][d] store the maximum length ending with value v and preceding absolute difference at least d.

hints.title: Suffix Maximums
hints.text: For each incoming element, compute transitions from previous values and maintain suffix maximums across difference dimensions.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintains 2D DP table over value and suffix differences with linear sweeps per element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard LIS variants without difference dimension cannot verify decreasing difference chains.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(max_val^2) table size is small and fixed under given constraints.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes value boundedness to index DP state by value and monotonic difference.
